description_en: Adds a forwarding rule to a specified HTTP or HTTPS listener
description_zh: 为指定的HTTP或HTTPS监听添加转发规则
name: CreateRules

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SLB instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SLB instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The frontend listener port used by the SLB instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的监听端口。

取值范围：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The frontend protocol used by the SLB instance.

This parameter is required when listeners of different protocols use the same port
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的协议。

相同端口存在不同协议监听时，此字段必选
parameters.name: listener_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The forwarding rules to be added. You can add up to 10 forwarding rules in a single request. Each forwarding rule includes the following parameters:

RuleName (required): String. The name of the forwarding rule. The name must be 1 to 40 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_). The names of different rules within the same listener must be unique.

Domain (optional): String. The request domain name associated with the forwarding rule. You must specify at least one of the Domain and Url parameters.

Url (optional): String. The access path. The path must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), percent signs (%), question marks (?), number signs (#), and ampersands (&). The URL cannot be only a forward slash (/) but must start with a forward slash (/). You must specify at least one of the Domain and Url parameters.

VServerGroupId (required): String. The ID of the destination vServer group for the forwarding rule.

You must specify at least one of the `Domain` and `Url` parameters, or specify both. The combination of `Domain` and `Url` must be unique within the same listener
parameters.help_zh:
要添加的转发规则。一次请求中，最多可添加10条转发规则。每条转发规则包含以下参数：

RuleName（必选）：String类型。转发规则名称，长度为1~40个字符，支持字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）和下划线（_）这些字符。同一个监听内不同规则的名称必须唯一。

Domain（可选）： String类型。转发规则关联的请求域名，与Url参数至少选择一个。

Url（可选）：String类型，可选，访问路径，长度限制为1~80个字符，只能使用中文、字母、数字和短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、百分号（%）、问号（?）、井号（#）和and（&）这些字符。 URL不能只为正斜线（/），但必须以正斜线（/）开头，与Domain参数至少选择一个。

VServerGroupId（必选）：String类型。该转发规则的目标虚拟服务器组ID。

`Domain`和`Url`两者必须指定一个，也可以同时指定。`Domain`和`Url`的组合在同一个监听内必须唯一
parameters.name: rule_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck this request. Valid values:

true: sends a precheck request without performing the operation. If the precheck succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request and performs the operation after the precheck succeeds
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会执行操作。如果检查通过，则返回错误码 `DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后执行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
